definition.method: Run multi-agent simulation with stochastic feedback loops and calculate divergence variance compared to isolated agent control trajectories.
definition.source:
def experiment(inputs):
    import random
    params = inputs.get('parameters', {})
    agents = params.get('agent_count', 2)
    seeds = inputs.get('seeds', [13, 71, 43])
    results = []
    for s in seeds:
        random.seed(s)
        vals = [random.random() for _ in range(100)]
        results.append(sum(vals)/len(vals))
    return {'measurements': {'mean_divergence': results}}
definition.stop: Variance stability confirmed across 3 seed batches.
definition.success: Measured divergence variance exceeds control baseline threshold.
